这一季的大结局围绕克莱尔组织一张完美的全家福展开。她希望整个大家庭都穿着白色衣服，一起站在楼梯上。对她来说，这不只是一张照片。孩子们长大得很快，她希望把这个家庭此刻的样子永远留住。

不幸的是，摄影师甚至还没到，几乎所有事情就都开始出错。背景里有一节坏掉的楼梯，克莱尔试图自己修好，却把问题弄得更加严重。海莉脸上长了一颗痘，想取消拍照，克莱尔却拒绝为了任何人改变计划。

与此同时，菲尔带亚历克斯和格洛丽亚、曼尼一起去看湖人队的比赛。菲尔出现在电视画面里时，克莱尔给他打了电话，但他玩得正开心，没有接听。几分钟后，现场的亲吻镜头对准了他和格洛丽亚。两个人起初都拒绝亲吻，可观众开始喝倒彩，格洛丽亚只好迅速亲了他一下。

克莱尔其实根本没看到那个吻，菲尔却以为她看见了，于是剩下的一整天都充满罪恶感。回到家后，他不停试图解释自己，尽管克莱尔真正生气的，只是他当时没有接电话。

卡梅隆受雇在一场婚礼上唱歌，米切尔却和莉莉留在家里，因为他讨厌和陌生人寒暄。卡梅隆唱歌时，一只鸽子飞进了他们家。米切尔彻底陷入恐慌，为了把它赶出去，毁坏了好几件家具和装饰品。卡梅隆回家后，两个人吵了起来，因为米切尔不仅缺席了对他很重要的一天，还把家里弄得一团糟。

卢克还需要为学校作业采访杰，了解二十世纪六十年代的生活。杰真实的故事实在太普通，卢克听得不断睡着，于是杰开始胡编乱造。很快，他声称自己家里的理发店曾经服务过马丁·路德·金、肯尼迪一家，甚至还有猫王。

等所有人终于换好衣服，站到镜头前时，那些一直隐藏着的矛盾全部爆发了。菲尔承认格洛丽亚亲了自己，卡梅隆抱怨米切尔没有参加婚礼，而克莱尔则越来越拼命地想让所有人看起来像一个正常、幸福的家庭。

杰最后告诉克莱尔，生活本来就不完美，随后把一团泥扔到了她身上。几秒钟内，所有人都加入了这场混战，原本洁白的衣服彻底沾满了泥。

奇怪的是，正是在这一刻，全家人才真正放松下来。他们浑身是泥地拍下了照片，不再摆姿势，而是自然地大笑。这不是克莱尔原本计划的完美全家福，但后来她意识到，这张照片反而更真实地拍出了他们这个家庭原本的样子。
paragraphs.english:
This season finale centers on Claire trying to organize one perfect family portrait. She wants the whole extended family dressed in white and standing together on the staircase. To her, it isn’t just a picture. The children are growing up quickly, and she wants to capture the family as it is right now.

Unfortunately, almost everything goes wrong before the photographer even arrives. A broken step is visible in the background, and Claire makes it much worse while trying to fix it herself. Haley gets a pimple and wants to cancel the picture, while Claire refuses to change the plan for anyone.

Meanwhile, Phil takes Alex to a Lakers game with Gloria and Manny. Claire calls him while he’s on television, but Phil ignores the call because he’s having fun. A few minutes later, the kiss cam lands on him and Gloria. They refuse to kiss at first, but the crowd starts booing, so Gloria quickly kisses him.

Claire doesn’t actually see the kiss, but Phil thinks she does and spends the rest of the day feeling guilty. When he gets home, he keeps trying to explain himself, even though Claire is mainly angry that he ignored her call.

Cameron has been hired to sing at a wedding, but Mitchell stays home with Lily because he hates making small talk with strangers. While Cameron is singing, a pigeon flies into their house. Mitchell completely panics and tries to chase it out, destroying several pieces of furniture and decorations in the process. When Cameron comes home, they argue because Mitchell skipped an important day for him and then ruined the house.

Luke also needs to interview Jay about life in the 1960s for a school project. Jay’s real stories are so ordinary that Luke keeps falling asleep, so Jay starts making things up. Soon, he’s claiming that his family’s barber shop served Martin Luther King Jr., the Kennedys, and even Elvis.

By the time everyone is finally dressed and standing in front of the camera, all the hidden arguments come out. Phil admits that Gloria kissed him, Cameron complains about Mitchell missing the wedding, and Claire becomes more desperate to make everyone look like a normal, happy family.

Jay finally tells Claire that life isn’t perfect and throws mud at her. Within seconds, everyone joins in, and their clean white clothes are completely ruined.

Strangely, that’s when the family finally relaxes. They take the picture covered in mud, laughing instead of posing. It isn’t the perfect portrait Claire planned, but later she realizes it’s a much better picture of what their family is really like.
